summary: Where each package belongs and why. Pick a row to see its purpose, where new code goes, what it imports and what imports it. Dependency numbers are read live from the source; descriptions are dated to the audit.

rules.title: Imports point down the layers
rules.detail: entry > app > domain > platform > foundation. Nothing imports internal/cli. The app packages are imported only from cli: hooks (also opencode, plus its hooks/* area packages), launch (cli only), configure (also ui/menu).

rules.title: Foundation stays stdlib-only
rules.detail: paths, proc, textutil, models, ui/ansi, shapes have no internal imports. Anything added here must keep that true. schemas (imports only paths) and audit sit just above.

rules.title: Never import a heavy package for a constant
rules.detail: If you need one path, name, header or lock from a big package, move that symbol down to a leaf instead. This is the main source of false height in the graph today.

rules.title: Nesting means a dependency of its parent
rules.detail: CLAUDE.md rule: a package more than one area imports stays top-level (router, ledger); a helper only one area uses nests under it (agent/tools). A directory is a namespace, not a layer. Before nesting or moving, run Import check.

rules.title: External SDKs are boxed in one package
rules.detail: CLAUDE.md rule. copilot boxes its SDK; anthropic-sdk-go lives in internal/claude by exception (the harness is Anthropic-centred); a third-party import outside its box is a finding. bbolt and mdsmith are unboxed libraries today.

rules.title: Break a cycle by moving code down, not by injecting
rules.detail: First extract the shared piece to a lower package. Injection is only for a true inversion (a low package must call a high one), and then as an explicit field on an options struct passed by the caller. No cross-package assignment from init().

rules.title: cli parses, engines work
rules.detail: internal/cli holds the verb table and flag handling; engines take typed options and return values. A verb file over 300 lines usually holds an engine. Exceptions today: databricks.Run, setup.Clean and review/* own their own flag parsing.

rules.title: *test packages are test-only
rules.detail: hosttest, pathstest and vaulttest are imported only from _test.go files, so their importer count reads 0 in production imports.

cmd.notHere: Anything else; there is only one binary.

internal.purpose: All Go packages of the binary.

internal/paths.purpose: Locates the config dir and state dirs; atomic and locked file writes; repo slug.
internal/paths.addHere: A location several packages need, including vendor homes (CODEX_HOME). Atomic file helpers.

internal/paths/pathstest.purpose: Isolated fake vendor executables for tests.

internal/proc.purpose: Process plumbing: liveness, detach, start time, env scrubbing, git env, WSL detection.
internal/proc.addHere: OS process primitives with per-platform files.
internal/proc.notHere: Anything knowing about providers or agents.

internal/notices.purpose: Per-session notice inboxes drained into hook context, and the read side of the hooks' claims ledger.
internal/notices.addHere: Cross-session file signals hooks and worktree both read.
internal/notices.notHere: Hook handlers or the claims writer (internal/hooks).

internal/inflight.purpose: Agent-inflight markers shared by the hook, the status line and agents reap; plus provider concurrency caps.
internal/inflight.notHere: Provider or quota logic; caps.go is the only reason this sits at L6.

internal/textutil.addHere: Small pure string helpers, including the shared shell-quote.

internal/models.purpose: Parses Claude model ids and derives per-model knobs (1M context, thinking, effort names).
internal/models.notHere: Which model to pick (router) or a provider's list (providers).

internal/schemas.purpose: Registry of versioned on-disk and wire formats; owners register their own rows.
internal/schemas.addHere: A new file format row (change protocol step 5).
internal/schemas.notHere: Format parsers; those stay with their owner.

internal/audit.purpose: Typed action log with no credential exposure; read by doctor --audit.

internal/completion.purpose: Renders and installs the bash completion script. Candidates live in cli/complete*.go.

internal/ui.purpose: Namespace for terminal output. Members span L0 to L11, so it does not imply a layer.

internal/ui/ansi.purpose: SGR escapes in truecolor, 256 and 16-colour modes; TTY check.

internal/ui/theme.purpose: Applies the tracked theme/ directory to each tool's config.

internal/ui/helptext.purpose: One flag-parsing and help-page format for every verb; --format handling.

internal/ui/tui.purpose: Raw-terminal pickers, confirm and secret prompts.
internal/ui/tui.notHere: Engine code should not call this directly; pass a callback.

internal/statusline.purpose: Renders Claude Code's status line in five styles from its JSON payload.
internal/statusline.notHere: Quota or provider logic. Reads proxy state and providers, so it is an app feature, not a UI primitive.

internal/vault.purpose: Encrypted bbolt store: sealed secrets, pins, env, overlays; master-key resolution; secret store (Store, Lookup, Get, Effective), probe metadata, dotenv import, credential-shape and git-history scans.
internal/vault.addHere: A new vault bucket or secret-store semantics.

internal/vault/vaultcmd.purpose: The vault verb: list, set, get, delete, import, export, edit, rotate-secret, the vault document editor, plus the vault list terminal and JSON rendering.
internal/vault/vaultcmd.addHere: A vault subcommand, the vault document editor or how vault list prints.

internal/vault/vaulttest.purpose: Throwaway vault for tests. Missing a package doc.

internal/shapes.purpose: The one credential-shape heuristic for printers and scanners.
internal/shapes.addHere: New token shapes (the Slack matcher dup belongs here).

internal/settings.purpose: Seeds a missing settings.json from template.json plus the hooks, resets it on the owner's request and checks it is valid (SeedSettings, ResetSettings, CheckFile); hook declarations (hookspec.go).
internal/settings.addHere: Hook specs, the settings template, seed, reset and validity rules.

internal/providers.purpose: Model-routing registry: upstreams, wire dialects, credential sources, tier pins; defaults.json; credential audits (scan, doctor, status).
internal/providers.addHere: A provider field or auth type.
internal/providers.notHere: The pick among providers (router) or the HTTP path (proxy).

internal/proxy/translate.purpose: Converts between Anthropic Messages and OpenAI chat completions.

internal/copilot.purpose: The copilot vendor: its driver, auth, model registry, catalog and ~/.copilot hook rendering; registers itself with agent; boxes copilot-sdk in sdk.go and sdk_permissions.go.
internal/copilot.addHere: Anything specific to the copilot CLI, including direct SDK use.
internal/copilot.notHere: Behaviour every agent shares; that is internal/agent.

internal/router.purpose: Agent+model pick: route table, candidate gates, BYOK pool, served cache, per-account quota state.
internal/router.notHere: HTTP forwarding (proxy) or running the agent (agent). Stays top-level: nine packages import it.

internal/databricks/serving.purpose: Databricks serving-endpoint discovery and probes: which models a workspace serves.
internal/databricks/serving.notHere: Agent dispatch; agents read the results.

internal/network/remote.purpose: Builds the ssh argv that runs a script on another host with stdin left free.
internal/network/remote.addHere: Remote-run argv shared by agents and network verbs.
internal/network/remote.notHere: Tailscale API calls; those are network/tailscale.

internal/proxy.purpose: Proxy client and daemon control: address, state, health, start/stop, session secret.
internal/proxy.addHere: What callers need to find or run the proxy.

internal/proxy/server.purpose: Loopback HTTP proxy Claude Code talks to: translation, cross-provider aliases, failover, usage ledger writes.
internal/proxy/server.notHere: Client-side helpers; those live in internal/proxy.

internal/agent.purpose: One headless task on any agent CLI under one retry loop. In practice also: launchers, config renderers, dispatch log, review, live sessions, roster.
internal/agent.addHere: Behaviour every agent shares, at the retry loop. Vendor quirks in the vendor's file.
internal/agent.notHere: Paths, tokens or names other packages need (paths); verb parsing (cli); prompts (cli callback).

internal/codex.purpose: The codex vendor: its driver, stream parser, argv, login, model catalog and ~/.codex config rendering; registers itself with agent.
internal/codex.addHere: Anything specific to the codex CLI.
internal/codex.notHere: Behaviour every agent shares; that is internal/agent.

internal/gemini.purpose: The gemini vendor (agy): its driver, stream parser, login and settings render; registers itself with agent.
internal/gemini.addHere: Anything specific to the agy CLI.
internal/gemini.notHere: Behaviour every agent shares; that is internal/agent.

internal/opencode.purpose: The opencode vendor: its driver, stream parser, argv, hub ladder, login, model menu and overlay rendering; registers itself with agent.
internal/opencode.addHere: Anything specific to the opencode CLI.
internal/opencode.notHere: Behaviour every agent shares; that is internal/agent.

internal/claude.purpose: The claude vendor: its driver, stream parser, launch plan, anthropic and science launches, the Anthropic secret flow (AnthropicSecret), one-shot API and live session; registers itself with agent.
internal/claude.addHere: Anything specific to the claude CLI.
internal/claude.notHere: Behaviour every agent shares; that is internal/agent.

internal/agent/batch.purpose: ask --batch: reads task lines and runs them through agent's shared dispatch limiter, one JSON envelope per task.
internal/agent/batch.addHere: Batch file parsing and the per-task run.

internal/agent/review.purpose: Review dispatch: diff scope, prompt, split into parts, merge part reports.

internal/agent/roles.purpose: claude-code dispatch roles: role table, legs per role, streamed parallel runner and report.
internal/agent/roles.addHere: A new dispatch role or leg shape.
internal/agent/roles.notHere: Verb parsing (cli); routing (router); the explore prompt and split (agent/explore).

internal/agent/pack.purpose: Inlines tracked workspace files into one prompt under a window-derived byte budget; never .env*, state/ or keys. Stdlib only.
internal/agent/pack.addHere: File selection, secret exclusion, prompt and index layout.

internal/agent/explore.purpose: Explore runs: the read-only brief prompt, the ask argv for <agent> explore, per-leg RunOptions and the haiku sub-question split.
internal/agent/explore.addHere: Explore prompt, tools rule or split behaviour.
internal/agent/explore.notHere: Leg fan-out and reports (agent/roles); verb parsing (cli).

internal/agent/live.purpose: Live interactive agent sessions: slot lock, session bookkeeping and ServeLive, which holds the agent child open behind its socket.

internal/agent/job.purpose: Background agent jobs: spawn, status, tail, find, signal.

internal/agent/answer.purpose: Structured answers: schema instruction, exact JSON decode, schema checks. Stdlib only.

internal/signin.purpose: Agent sign-in: login checks, launch-time login and GitHub token validation.
internal/signin.notHere: Vendor login internals; those stay in the vendor package.

internal/agentconfig.purpose: Agent config: agents.json defaults, routing settings fields, codex TOML/trust/overlay and the opencode overlay render.
internal/agentconfig.addHere: Config shape and the pure renderers.

internal/agentconfig/template.purpose: Embedded templates for agent config renders.

internal/agentconfig/render.purpose: Shared config write path for agent configs: render, baseline, revert.
internal/agentconfig/render.addHere: Writing a vendor config with a backup, its baseline and reverting it.

internal/agentconfig/render/rendertest.purpose: Shared hermetic fixture for vendor render tests.

internal/hooks/memhook/memhooktest.purpose: Stubs memhook detached spawns for tests.

internal/agent/agenttest.purpose: Stubs the agent router so tests spawn no proxy daemon.

internal/agentconfig/project.purpose: Projects agents/ into each agent's subagent dir, links skills, renders global instruction files. Imported by agent.

internal/preflight.purpose: Per-agent pin check and post-install pong round. Missing a package doc.

internal/agent/tools.purpose: Installs and updates agent CLIs into ~/.claude/bin.

internal/agent/tree.purpose: Live tree of sessions, subagents and dispatches; reap; the view behind agents tree, network view and the page. Missing a package doc.

internal/memory.purpose: Per-repo and home memory banks: blocks, recall, embeddings, update, dream, promote, native MEMORY.md.
internal/memory.notHere: Store identity, paths and the bank lock (internal/memstore).

internal/memstore.purpose: Locates a memory store and locks it: identity, origin records, store paths, repo routing, bank lock, native links.
internal/memstore.addHere: What a package needs to find or lock a store without the engine.
internal/memstore.notHere: Bank, recall or update code; it imports none of memory, hooks, cli, agent, settings or proxy.

internal/memory/bank.purpose: Bank file layer: entries, blocks, segments, ids, tags, catalog writes, remember.

internal/memory/recall.purpose: Recall: picks bank entries for a prompt by relevance.

internal/memory/recall/embed.purpose: Embedding vectors for semantic recall, refreshed in the background.

internal/ui/dialog.purpose: Dialog shell for configure pages: paged menu, Enter/Esc, numbered prompt off a terminal.

internal/ui/table.purpose: Column-aligned terminal tables: render, style per row, drop empty columns, truncate.
internal/ui/table.notHere: The data a table shows (its caller).

internal/ui/menu.purpose: Menu row layout: aligned columns, state brackets, section titles and the Enter row.
internal/ui/menu.addHere: Generic menu mechanics a page hands plain rows and callbacks.

internal/ui/tree.purpose: Terminal rendering of agent/tree data: agents tree text, the network view drill-down and its follow lines.
internal/ui/tree.addHere: How the tree or a snapshot prints.
internal/ui/tree.notHere: Scanning or data (agent/tree). network/web uses agent/tree directly, never this package.

internal/memory/templates.purpose: Embedded bank file templates used by memory init.

internal/transcript.purpose: Reads Claude Code session JSONL: context size, files written; builds the session transfer handoff.
internal/transcript.addHere: Transcript parsing and transfer handoff building.

internal/usage.purpose: Token totals, peak rate, per-agent stores, live plan quotas, workflow rollups.
internal/usage.notHere: Ledger writes (internal/tokenledger, kept light for the proxy).

internal/tokenledger.purpose: Per-token ledger the proxy appends to and usage reads.
internal/tokenledger.notHere: Imports heavier than paths and schemas.

internal/plans.purpose: Parses plan checklists; ticks, claims, status; plan mirror records.
internal/plans.notHere: Plan linting (review/planlint), a different thing with nearly the same name.

internal/history.purpose: Shadow git history of config files.
internal/history.notHere: Memory history. Imports agent for one path.

internal/worktree.purpose: Lifecycle of ~/worktrees/<repo>/<name>: create, classify, verified merge, ledger.

internal/network.purpose: Namespace for things that reach past this machine. Members span L1 to L10.

internal/network/browser.purpose: Detects browser control paths (extension host, CDP, WebDriver) and scrapes pages.
internal/network/browser.notHere: Internal imports beyond paths; it is correctly low.

internal/network/mcp.purpose: Read-only MCP config and health diagnostic, plus the stdio web-search server.

internal/network/tailscale.purpose: Tailscale admin API, tailscale CLI, remote ssh runner.
internal/network/tailscale.notHere: Generic shell quoting and host validation; agent imports this package only for those.

internal/network/vscode.purpose: Merges VS Code settings templates; serves code serve-web on the tailnet; links the extension.
internal/network/vscode.notHere: Note it is both a local config merge and a network server.

internal/network/web.purpose: The network page dashboard: agents, plans, usage, this page.
internal/network/web.addHere: A dashboard tab and its endpoint.
internal/network/web.notHere: Engines. Imports agent only for DispatchDir.

internal/network/web/assets.purpose: Embedded page template and this audit's content.

internal/network/web/assets/usage.purpose: go:generate copies of vscode/claude-code-agents/lib modules. Edit the originals.

internal/databricks.purpose: Launches Claude Code on Databricks serving; login, mint, import/export, smoke checks. Owns its own verb tree.

internal/databricks/oauth.purpose: Stdlib-only token mint: U2M PKCE, refresh, M2M. providers imports it directly.

internal/databricks/templates.purpose: Embedded claude and codex config templates.

internal/desktop.purpose: Claude Desktop gateway profile with no embedded credentials.

internal/clipboard.purpose: WSL image paste workaround, wl-paste proxy, macOS launchd bridge.

internal/review.purpose: Namespace for deterministic detectors (source, diff, planlint).

internal/testtool.purpose: Namespace for test tooling (mutate, ramdisk) that the test verb exposes.

internal/review/source.purpose: Quality and complexity detectors over source files; review-simplicity hook input.

internal/review/diff.purpose: Diff surgeon, PR analysis, report generation, advisory gate.

internal/review/planlint.purpose: Plan linters (assumptions, goals), workflow skeleton and lint.

internal/testtool/mutate.purpose: Mutation check via go -overlay, behind claude-code test mutate.
internal/testtool/mutate.addHere: Test tooling behind the test verb.

internal/testtool/ramdisk.purpose: Runs a command with TMPDIR on an APFS RAM disk, behind claude-code test ramdisk.
internal/testtool/ramdisk.addHere: Test tooling behind the test verb.

internal/hooks.purpose: The hook event engine only (dispatch.go): the Native registry, the Event dispatcher and the `hook` verb's runners; the handlers live in hooks/agents, hooks/docs, hooks/memhook, hooks/quality, hooks/safety and hooks/wthook.
internal/hooks.addHere: Event dispatch or registry wiring; declare a handler in settings/hookspec.go and write it in its area.
internal/hooks.notHere: A hook handler (its area package) or shared logic other packages import.

internal/hooks/agents.purpose: The agent-dispatch hook area: dispatch effort pin, in-flight cap claim and release, leaf-stop gate and reaper, Codex routing and its audit log.
internal/hooks/agents.addHere: A subagent-dispatch, Codex routing or leaf-stop hook module or its helper.
internal/hooks/agents.notHere: The roster and router pick logic (agent, router) or the in-flight ledger itself (inflight).

internal/hooks/core.purpose: Shared hook types: Input, Result, Runner, exit codes and output encoding for every hook module.
internal/hooks/core.addHere: A type or helper every hook module needs.
internal/hooks/core.notHere: Hook modules, the Native registry or the dispatcher (hooks).

internal/hooks/docs.purpose: The docs hook area: doc placement gate, plan template gate, plan save, mirror, skeleton, task ticking and path resolving.
internal/hooks/docs.addHere: A docs or plan hook module or its helper.

internal/hooks/memhook.purpose: The memory hook area: session start, recall, update gates, catch-up sweep and idle watcher.
internal/hooks/memhook.addHere: A memory hook module or its helper.
internal/hooks/memhook.notHere: Bank storage and recall ranking (memory, memory/recall).

internal/hooks/quality.purpose: The quality hook area: review-simplicity advisory, stop-time formatting and the Workflow pin lint.
internal/hooks/quality.addHere: A code-quality hook module or its helper.
internal/hooks/quality.notHere: Simplicity detectors (internal/review/source) or workflow pin rules (internal/review/planlint).

internal/hooks/safety.purpose: The safety hook area: safety-scan command gate, the rtk output rewrite and the copilot-bash allowlist guard.
internal/hooks/safety.addHere: A command-safety, rtk or copilot-bash hook module or its helper.
internal/hooks/safety.notHere: The shell allowlist or shell parsing (internal/shell).

internal/hooks/wthook.purpose: The worktree hook area: worktree create and remove, mode and busy notes, config sweep, file claims, claim check and peer lookups.
internal/hooks/wthook.addHere: A worktree, claims or notice hook module or its helper.
internal/hooks/wthook.notHere: Worktree creation and merge logic (worktree) or the claims reader (notices).

internal/shell.purpose: Shell command parsing shared by hooks and transcript (segments, words, substitutions, wrapper unwrapping, git invocations) and the scoped allowlist shared by copilot's permission handler and the copilot-bash hook; resolves the rtk binary (RTKBinary).
internal/shell.addHere: Parsing of shell command text that more than one hook needs; allowlisted command shapes, their workdir checks and the rtk binary lookup.
internal/shell.notHere: Hook verdicts or heredoc handling; permission decisions (internal/copilot) or hook wiring (internal/hooks).

internal/launch.purpose: Misnamed: install steps, doctor checks, tmux config and restore. Settings write logic lives in settings; launching itself is agent/launch_*.go.

internal/setup.purpose: adopt, nuke and workspace modes behind install --setup, plus the state sweep behind claude-code clean (owns its own flags). Its doc still names a removed setup verb.
internal/setup.addHere: Destructive tree migrations; a new clean sweep target.

internal/configure.purpose: The headless setup service layer used by ui/menu and cli: provider, models, agents, routing, GitHub, apply and secrets operations. The TUI pages are internal/ui/menu.
internal/configure.addHere: A setup operation with no terminal UI.
internal/configure.notHere: TUI pages (internal/ui/menu), the vault editor (internal/vault/vaultcmd) or writes other verbs also perform; call the owner.

internal/cli.purpose: Verb table, help, completion spec and verb handlers. Imports 81 packages by design.
internal/cli.addHere: A verb's flag parsing and printing.
internal/cli.notHere: Engines. cmd_agent.go, memory.go, network_tailscale.go, worktree.go, providers.go and complete_spec.go are over 300 lines.

internal/cli/agents.purpose: The ask, dispatch and agents verbs and the agent client; the agents tree.
internal/cli/agents.addHere: An ask, dispatch or agents subcommand handler.

internal/hosttest.purpose: Gives each test binary a clean host: no agent CLIs, no credentials, throwaway HOME.

internal/hosttest/gittest.purpose: Fresh one-commit git repo per test, copied from a once-built template.

agents.purpose: Subagent definitions, flat; name: must equal the file stem. Projected into other agents' homes.
agents.addHere: A new subagent (change protocol: manifest first).

commands.purpose: Slash commands, flat; thin launchers into an agent or skill.

workflows.purpose: Saved Workflow tool scripts: code-agent, code-analyzer, code-engineer, green-keeper-loop.

rules.purpose: Rule files loaded by scope; contract in rules/README.md.

rules/standards.purpose: Always-on rules. Every line costs every session.

rules/workflows.purpose: Agent and memory workflow rules; needs paths: scoping.

rules/harness.purpose: Rules for working on the harness itself; needs paths: scoping.

skills.purpose: On-demand references. Untracked dirs are the user's own symlinks; synced/ is re-downloaded from claude.ai.
skills.addHere: A tracked skill, after a license check.

skills/evaluate-code.purpose: Audit, review and security lenses; wraps claude-code review.

skills/problem-solving.purpose: The evidence loop for a task, fix or plan.

skills/subagent-workflows.purpose: Choosing and running multi-agent work; handoff contract.

skills/web-search.purpose: Tavily search fallback through network websearch.

skills/evaluate-code/references.purpose: Lens checklists the skill loads on demand.

skills/problem-solving/references.purpose: Mode references for the evidence loop.

docs.purpose: Only images/ and templates/ are allowed here (docs-placement gate).

docs/images.purpose: README images, including the help-svg output.

docs/templates.purpose: Golden examples of rendered settings and memory.

theme.purpose: One JSON per tool; applied by theme apply.

vscode/claude-code-agents/lib.purpose: Shared usage modules; the source for web/assets/usage.
vscode/claude-code-agents/lib.addHere: Usage rendering; then go generate in internal/network/web.

.github.purpose: CI workflows, dependabot, issue and PR templates, SECURITY.md.

.githooks.purpose: Tracked git hooks; pre-push runs make audit.

opus.note: Launches Claude on the alias. -h prints upstream claude help, not harness help.

fable.note: -h fails on a profile with no fable pin.

anthropic.note: Hidden but named in the menu header.

copilot.note: Same verb set as codex, gemini, opencode through AgentVerb.

codex.note: -f means config.toml here but follow on tail.

gemini.note: Same verb set as the other agents; large-context packs go through ask --dirs.

opencode.note: Menu and -h name different plans. catalog has its own sub-verbs.

databricks.note: Filed under AGENTS but it launches Claude on a provider. Owns its own parsing.

vault.note: internal/vault/vaultcmd holds the verb and the vault list renderer.

network.note: view and restart are not network verbs.

switch.note: One of three ways to pin a profile.

test.note: Verb and package tree disagree. Help mentions only mutate -h.

memory.note: Ten plumbing verbs off the menu; output still says memory doctor.

doctor.note: Mode flags pick unrelated jobs: health, audit log, secret scan.

gateway.note: Three names for one concern: gateway, router, proxy.

describe.note: Reads the completion spec, so it under-reports flags.

install.note: --setup nuke is a destructive mode behind an install flag.

theme.note: statusline is a runtime renderer filed under theme.

help-svg.note: Build tool for the README image.

ask.note: The most-used verb, hidden from the menu. --job and --stdin-framed are internal flags shown in -h.

agents.note: Hidden. status, result, tail, cancel repeat the per-agent verbs.

models.note: Hidden, but named in configure help and in errors.

review.note: Hidden. Deterministic detectors, while <agent> review is an LLM review. Uses --json, not --format.

hook.note: Hidden on purpose: settings.json runs it.
